title: omission-a draft v1: markdown source merged with DOCX structure, no synthetic numbers carried forward

goal.text: A single text-only draft carrying the intended voice and argument, with every unverified number held in an explicit placeholder rather than inherited from the synthetic census.
goal.falsifier: Closed when all 20 [[STAT]] slots are filled from named scripts with receipts and no [[CONFLICT]] marker remains.

notes: STEP 1 of the agreed four-step plan. Output: context/omission-a-draft-v1.md, text only, no figures embedded.

MERGE SOURCES: context/04_draft_biorxiv_markdown.md supplied the abstract framing, the full Introduction argument, the terminology table, the condition notation, and the authorial voice; context/omission-a-2026-manuscript-v2-provenance.docx supplied the section scaffold; context/PUBLICATION_STYLE_CRITERIA.md supplied the length, statistics, voice and caption targets.

DECISION: no numeric value from the previous DOCX was carried into v1. Twenty [[STAT]] placeholders mark every quantity that requires a computation not yet run. This is deliberate — importing the hardcoded literals would have reintroduced the defect documented in census_provenance_synthetic_finding_20260728.

SUBJECT COUNT RESOLVED (Hamm, 2026-07-28): N = 3 is current. The source markdown states N = 2 because it predates the addition of the third subject. Every count inherited from that markdown — including the ~20 omission-positive of ~5,000 screened — describes the earlier two-subject corpus and is a lower bound. Recorded in the draft as a provenance comment rather than a live conflict.

AREA ORDER ADOPTED FROM THE MARKDOWN: V1, V2, V3d, V3a, V4, MT, MST, TEO, FST, FEF, PFC — eleven areas with V3d and V3a separate. This supersedes the DOCX's ten-area 'V3a-d-v' collapse and matches the labels actually present in the time-frequency corpus.

BASELINE DEFINITION ADOPTED FROM THE MARKDOWN: -250 to -50 ms relative to OMISSION onset (late pre-omission delay), on an omission-relative time base with 0 ms at the expected onset of the missing stimulus, window -1000 to +1000 ms. This supersedes the p1-relative fx baseline (-500 to -50 ms) used in the exploratory census run earlier this session, and the exploratory run should be re-executed under it.

BLOCKER RESOLVED AS SPECIFICATION: the markdown's Methods already prescribe the fix for the area-aliasing blocker — 'when a probe was assigned to multiple areas, its ordered channel axis was partitioned into contiguous segments corresponding to those listed areas', applied to LFP and MUAe channels, with spike-sorted units assigned by anchor or peak channel. Step 3 is therefore an implementation task, not an open research question.

STATISTICS SECTION written to the house limit: four inferential families total — GLMM as the single backbone (binomial logit for class membership, identity link for band power in dB, random intercepts for subject and session, session as the unit of inference), Wilcoxon rank-sum for within-unit contrasts, cluster-based permutation for time-frequency, Clopper-Pearson for proportions. Rank correlations demoted to descriptive. Bootstrap eliminated.
ABSTRACT contains no statistics, matching the exemplar (Westerberg & Xiong 2025 reports none in its abstract).

MEASURED WORD COUNTS (placeholders and HTML comments excluded): Abstract 231 (target 220-280, MET), Introduction 1,033 (target 800-1100, MET), Methods 1,524 (target 3500-4500, SHORT), Results 670 (target 2000-2600, SHORT), Discussion 1,017 (target 2000-2500, SHORT), figure captions 425. Total prose 4,944 words. 39 ### citation markers.

Methods shortfall is dominated by facts absent from BOTH source documents: surgery and implant, stimulus specification (size, contrast, spatial and temporal frequency, eccentricity), fixation window and reward schedule, spike-sorting parameters and quality tiers, CSD computation, and per-model GLMM specifications.
Discussion shortfall is the one gap that can be closed immediately — it depends on argument, not on new numbers.
issues: Results is the shortest section and cannot be completed before step 3 supplies segmented per-channel numbers.

Eight figure slots against a five-figure house standard. Figures 1-4 accepted by Hamm as-is pending a later quality pass; 5, 6, 7 and 8 carry explicit alignment specifications in the draft and must be rebuilt on segmented channels.

Direction of the low-frequency effect remains unsettled: the prior draft asserts sustained beta elevation, the direct computation on unsegmented arrays gives a broad decrease. Not resolvable until segmentation is applied.
Author list is still incomplete in both source documents.

Three reference defects carried forward and flagged in the References section rather than silently fixed: Wacongne 2011 (J Neurosci entry with a PNAS DOI), Bastos 2015 (Neuron 85(2) with a 2015.09 DOI suffix), and Rao & Ballard 1999 cited for a laminar claim that belongs to Bastos 2012.
Putative layer assignment via the spectrolaminar alpha-beta-to-gamma crossover (vflip) is specified in Methods but not yet computed; it is part of step 3.
plan: Step 2: integrity pass — whitespace, empty pages, condensing; expand Discussion toward 2,000-2,500 words, which needs no new computation.
Step 3: implement the contiguous-segment per-channel area vector plus putative layer from vflip, then re-run the band-power census on the omission-relative baseline and fit the GLMM.
Step 4: draft v2 with [[STAT]] slots filled and figures 5-8 rebuilt.

verification.receipt: Word counts measured on the written file with HTML comments and [[...]] placeholders stripped by regex. Placeholder census: 20 [[STAT]], 3 [[CONFLICT]], 39 ### citation markers. Grep confirms the single remaining 'N = 2' occurrence is inside the provenance comment explaining the resolution, not a live claim.

links.reasoning: v1 is written against the measured house targets for length, statistical family count, abstract content and voice.
No hardcoded value survives into v1; every affected quantity is an explicit placeholder naming the computation owed.
The markdown's contiguous-segment partition is the specified fix; v1 records it in Methods and marks all area-resolved results as pending re-derivation under it.
The three-identical-empty-periods structure and the middle-slot logic are written into the paradigm subsection of Methods.
v1 replaces the DOCX line as the working draft; the integrity edits are folded in and the synthetic numbers are dropped rather than corrected.
